## Prime-Agent System Prompt (ACP Template)

For file editing operations, the prime-agent runtime exposes a pre-installed `mcp` Python object with `list_tools` and `call_tool` methods. Use them to discover and invoke tools.

Example discovery and call:

```python
tools_list = await mcp.list_tools("tools")
for t in tools_list:
    print(t["name"], t["inputSchema"])

result = await mcp.call_tool("tools", "ox-bridge-write", {"path": "/tmp/x.py", "content": "# code here"})
print(result)
```

The `tools` MCP server exposes:
- `ox-bridge-write`: write a file (args: `path`, `content`)
- `ox-bridge-edit`: edit a file with hunks (args: `path`, `edits` = [{old, new}])
- `ox-bridge-read`: read a file region (args: `path`, `start`, `end`)

All bridging calls return synchronously. Print results to confirm before proceeding.

content.thinking: The failure: round-trip without optional fields — parseMeta returns type: 'website' but input has no type. The test expects equality with input lacking `type`. Options: make renderMeta only emit og:type when provided, or default it. Spec says "standard og pairs" — og:type is standard, defaults to website. But round-trip equality for canonical inputs. Simplest fix: in parseMeta, omit type if not present in HTML... but renderMeta always emits og:type (defaulting to website). Better: only emit og:type when type is provided; then parseMeta omits it too when absent. That keeps round-trip exact for inputs without type. Update both meta.js and keep tests.

## Files

- `/workspace/metagen/src/meta.js` — `renderMeta`, `parseMeta`, plus helpers `escapeAttr` and `truncateDescription`
- `/workspace/metagen/test/meta.test.js` — Vitest suite
- `/workspace/metagen/package.json`

## Behavior

- **`renderMeta({...})`** emits `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, the og pairs (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `og:site_name`, `og:type` when provided), Twitter card (`summary_large_image` with an image, else `summary`), and `<link rel="canonical">`. All attribute values are HTML-escaped (including quotes → `"`). Optional fields (`url`, `image`, `siteName`, `type`) are omitted from output when absent so round-trip stays exact.
- **Truncation**: 155-char cap on a word boundary; trailing commas/whitespace trimmed so nothing dangles.
- **`parseMeta(html)`** uses cheerio to invert it back to the options object (canonical link wins as `url`).

One fix along the way: `og:type` was being defaulted to `'website'` on render even for inputs without `type`, which broke exact round-trip equality — now it's only emitted/parsed when present.

Test coverage: round-trip (full + minimal inputs), truncation boundary (length ≤ 155, prefix property proves no mid-word cut, no dangling comma/space), quote escaping in title (+ escaped-quote round-trip), and card-type switching.
